pairs: And the Lord said to Moses:
Nunc videbis quæ facturus sim Pharaoni:
“Now you will see what I shall do to Pharaoh.
per manum enim fortem dimittet eos,
For through a strong hand he will release them,
et in manu robusta ejiciet illos de terra sua.
and by a mighty hand he will cast them from his land.”
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen dicens:
And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
Isaac et Jacob in Deo omnipotente:
to Isaac, and to Jacob as Almighty God.
et nomen meum Adonai non indicavi eis.
And I did not reveal to them my name: ADONAI.
And I formed a covenant with them,
in order to give them the land of Canaan,
I have heard the groaning of the sons of Israel,
with which the Egyptians have oppressed them.
And I have remembered my covenant.
Ego Dominus qui educam vos de ergastulo Ægyptiorum,
say to the sons of Israel:
I am the Lord who will lead you away from the work house of the Egyptians,
and also redeem you with an exalted arm and great judgments.
Et assumam vos mihi in populum,
And I will take you to myself as my people,
and I will be your God.
et scietis quod ego sum Dominus Deus vester qui eduxerim vos de ergastulo Ægyptiorum,
And you will know that I am the Lord your God, who led you away from the work house of the Egyptians,
and who brought you into the land,
super quam levavi manum meam ut darem eam Abraham,
over which I lifted up my hand in order to grant it to Abraham,
And I will grant it to you as a possession.
Narravit ergo Moyses omnia filiis Israël:
And so, Moses explained all these things to the sons of Israel,
qui non acquieverunt ei propter angustiam spiritus, et opus durissimum.
who did not agree with him, because of their anguish of spirit and very difficult work.
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
et loquere ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti,
ut dimittat filios Israël de terra sua.
so that he may release the sons of Israel from his land.”
Moses responded in the sight the Lord:
Ecce filii Israël non audiunt me:
“Behold, the sons of Israel do not listen to me.
And how will Pharaoh listen to me,
especially since I am of uncircumcised lips?”
Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen et Aaron, et dedit mandatum ad filios Israël,
And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, and he gave them a commandment for the sons of Israel,
et ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti ut educerent filios Israël de terra Ægypti.
and for Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, that they should lead the sons of Israel away from the land of Egypt.
Isti sunt principes domorum per familias suas.
These are the leaders of the houses by their families.
The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel:
These are the kindred of Reuben.
the son of a Canaanite women.
These are the progeny of Simeon.
Et hæc nomina filiorum Levi per cognationes suas:
And these are the names of the sons of Levi by their kindred:
Anni autem vitæ Levi fuerunt centum triginta septem.
Now the years of the life of Levi were one hundred and thirty-seven.
anni quoque vitæ Caath, centum triginta tres.
the years of the life of Kohath were one hundred and thirty-three.
hæ cognationes Levi per familias suas.
These are the kindred of Levi by their families.
Accepit autem Amram uxorem Jochabed patruelem suam:
Now Amram took as a wife Jochebed,
quæ peperit ei Aaron et Moysen.
who bore for him Aaron and Moses.
And the years of the life of Amram were one hundred and thirty-seven.
Accepit autem Aaron uxorem Elisabeth filiam Aminadab,
Now Aaron took as a wife Elizabeth, the daughter of Amminadab,
These are the kindred of the Korahites.
At vero Eleazar filius Aaron accepit uxorem de filiabus Phutiel:
And truly Eleazar, the son of Aaron, took a wife from the daughters of Putiel.
Hi sunt principes familiarum Leviticarum per cognationes suas.
These are the heads of the Levitical families by their kindred.
quibus præcepit Dominus ut educerent filios Israël de terra Ægypti per turmas suas.
whom the Lord instructed to lead the sons of Israel away from the land of Egypt by their companies.
These are those who speak to Pharaoh,
qui loquuntur ad Pharaonem regem Ægypti,
ut educant filios Israël de Ægypto:
in order to lead the sons of Israel out of Egypt.
in die qua locutus est Dominus ad Moysen, in terra Ægypti.
in the day when the Lord spoke to Moses in the land of Egypt.
Et locutus est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
Speak to Pharaoh, king of Egypt,
all that I speak to you.”
And Moses said in the sight of the Lord:
how will Pharaoh listen to me?”
